SELECT eamfv.VDS_NM, SUM(avcic.TRFVLM) as SUM_TRFVLM, ROUND(SUM(avcic.TRFVLM) / COUNT(eamfv.VDS_NM),2) as AVG_TRFVLM, ROUND(SUM(avcic.AVG_SPEED) / COUNT(eamfv.VDS_NM),2) as AVG_SPD, cgslam.ROAD_NAME FROM adsi_vds_colct_info_cur avcic INNER JOIN ADSI_M_FA_VDS eamfv ON avcic.VDS_ID = eamfv.VDS_ID INNER JOIN ADSI_VDS_SCTN_INFO avsi ON avcic.VDS_ID = avsi.VDS_ID INNER JOIN ADSI_VDS_SCTN_STLINK_MPPG avssm ON avsi.vds_sctn_id = avssm.vds_sctn_id INNER JOIN C_GM_STD_LINK_ADSTDG_MPPG cgslam ON avssm.STD_LINK_ID = cgslam.LINK_ID WHERE 1=1
GROUP BY eamfv.VDS_NM, cgslam.ROAD_NAME ORDER BY cgslam.ROAD_NAME
LIMIT 10 OFFSET (#{page} - 1) * 10
